user_direction: Desktop web now. Hosting/sharing on hold. Preserve final nationwide and specialist scope.
parallel_discovery_note: Begin official access/validity/geography work early; no requirement to wait for every other stage.

stages.title: Answer fidelity and task coverage
deliverables: Claim attribution tuples and deterministic factual rendering
Typed task list, operations and date ranges
Task-level coverage status and accepted entity state
exit_checks: Every requested subtask completed or explicitly missing

stages.title: Everyday forecast and research answers
deliverables: Hourly timeline and exact supported interval operations
Descriptive comparisons, baselines, trends and charts
exit_checks: Probability semantics and variable lineage validated
Daily questions never become annual lookups
Independent calculation oracles and missingness gates pass

stages.title: Specialist adapter activation
deliverables: Typed specialist entities and unified source budgets
exit_checks: No closure, flight disruption or flood impact claims without evidence

stages.title: Official warnings and document retrieval
deliverables: Lexical plus dense retrieval with citations
exit_checks: Updated bulletins supersede current retrieval versions
Wrong-place/time/crop retrieval and citation-support tests pass

stages.title: Language, resilience and desktop usability
deliverables: Desktop answer charts and source inspection
exit_checks: Fluent review and desktop journey checks pass

deliverable_state.Desktop answer charts and source inspect: implemented and recorded: answer-first headline, validity ruler, structured evidence receipt, series receipt, per-answer actions and a print path
deliverable_state.Source health/retention/restore rehearsa: implemented and recorded: conversation ledger with search, restore and local delete, plus a read-only collection-health panel
deliverable_state.Queue, cancel, progress and recovery: cancel and progress only: a stop control and an elapsed-time indicator exist, and the page states that stopping does not cancel server work and nothing is queued; there is still no bounded model queue and no stage streaming
deliverable_state.Complete Hindi/Gujarati dialogue paths: not achieved: a requested output language is expressible and its failure is disclosed, but fluent output has not been produced or reviewed

stages.title: Later voice, mobile and distribution
exit_checks: User-approved sharing readiness and verified deployed journeys

latest_batch.scope: Accessible product behavior on the desktop surface: answer-first presentation, source inspection, honest state and language reporting, bounded collection control, cancellation, and local retention and health surfaces. No bounded queue, no stage streaming, no fluent language review, no accessibility audit and no mobile acceptance.

review_mapping.trajectory: docs/21 step 4 (accessible product behavior and dependable operation)

next_batch_note: The desktop surface now presents answers, receipts and limits in a usable form, and the stored conversations can be listed, restored and deleted locally. The engine-side gaps in docs/21 A01-A04 remain the highest-value work: the interface is clearer, but it cannot make A01 context retention, A02 language output or A05 official warning applicability correct. Official warning and observation feasibility still needs a user decision on supported official data access before implementation.
